topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints significantly influence payload power allocation by prioritizing immediate services to prevent data congestion and ensuring timely processing of time-tagged services. Dynamic power allocation, predictive analytics, and queueing theory optimize storage and power management, minimizing delays and maximizing system efficiency.
reference_context: Satellites have limited on-board memory, requiring efficient storage and power management to prevent data congestion and ensure timely service delivery.
